enriched.fulltitle: Unlock ultra-convenient on-the-go charging with the new HaloLock™ 10,000mAh Kickstand Power Bank
enriched.description:
The HaloLock™ Kickstand Wireless Power Bank is a MagSafe wireless power bank with a capacity of 10,000mAh that begins charging as soon you magnetically attach it to your iPhone. The built-in adjustable kickstand and pass-through charging capability also let you use it as a MagSafe wireless charging stand and ensure that you can find a comfortable angle to FaceTime friends or catch up on your favorite shows. It's the perfect companion for any adventure.
